$description: Hand-authored semantic text foreground colors. Role-based, not hue-based — every token describes what the text IS for, not what colour it happens to be. Consumed by every component that sets `color`.

text.$description: Semantic text colors — role-based, not hue-based.

primary.$description: Default body text on dark backgrounds.

accent.$description: Emphasised text with teal brand accent.

inverse.$description: Text on bright fills — the owner's deepest navy, hsl(222 84% 5%), never black.
